title: LYDERSHOLM rug flatwoven
description: LYDERSHOLM rug flatwoven, in/outdoor, medium brown, 6'7"x9'10" LYDERSHOLM rug upgrades your dining area with a natural, rustic expression. It’s durable and easy to clean making it a good choice for outdoor- and heavy-use areas. The color and weave create a natural look.
features: You will need 2 STOPP FILT rug underlay with anti-slip (5'5"x7'9") for this rug. Trim if necessary.
This rug fits with a 2-3 seat sofa, but can also fit other size sofas depending on how you place it.
This rug fits under a 6-seat dining table, but can of course be used how and where you like in your home.
Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.
Rugs with structure or hard edges can cause marks on soft wooden floors even when used together with an anti-slip underlay.
materialAndCare: Use surface: 100 % polypropylene; Backing: 100 % Synthetic rubber
